definitions.ask: On a closed entry's live link whose task is already Done, should Ctrl+Enter only strike the link?
definitions.why: A closed entry is history; pressing on a live link to a finished task means mark it done

choices.label: Writes reconcile's 🍅 ~~[[X]]~~ and leaves the task Done; a second press reopens it
Keeps today's toggle: reopens the task (restoring it from done/) and leaves the line live
